h1: SEO Expert for law firms Tired of Losing Clients to Competitors
intro: Clients looking for a law firm start with Google almost every time. Ranking well is not a nice-to-have in this industry — it is how the phone keeps ringing. Practice-area pages must rank individually; homepage ranking wins nothing. Attorney bios with case results persuade more than firm history. Bar advertising rules restrict testimonials and outcome claims. Local pack plus LSAs dominate; organic fills the research phase. That is why law firms businesses need an SEO approach designed around how their clients actually search, compare, and choose. Local SEO is a long game, but every month of consistent work compounds: better rankings bring more calls, more calls bring more reviews, and more reviews push rankings higher still. Businesses that commit to the process pull away from competitors that dabble.

faqs.q: Should my law firm focus on Google Ads or SEO?
faqs.a: Ads buy visibility today; SEO builds an asset that keeps producing. practice-area pages must rank individually; homepage ranking wins nothing, so most successful law firms run both — ads for now, SEO for compounding growth.

faqs.q: What should I look for in an SEO expert for law firms?
faqs.a: Industry experience matters more than anything: attorney bios with case results persuade more than firm history. Ask for proof of rankings and revenue impact in your field, not just generic reports.

faqs.q: How long does SEO take for law firms?
faqs.a: Typically 3–6 months for meaningful traction, because practice-area pages must rank individually; homepage ranking wins nothing. Competitive niches take longer, but the clients you win are worth far more than the wait.
